facts.value: An application without a completed Bachelor's degree is possible if at least 80% of the required credits from the Bachelor's program have been completed by the time of application.
If you have not yet completed your Bachelor's degree, please apply with the following additional application documents by May 15.
Proof of enrollment in the Bachelor's program and a preliminary transcript showing an average grade and all previous examination results.
The preliminary transcript must be issued by an authorized institution for grading.
The 80% criterion is binding and exceptions are unfortunately not possible.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 180 ECTS; Minimum ECTS for application: 144 ECTS.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 210 ECTS; Minimum ECTS for application: 168 ECTS.
Maximum ECTS Bachelor's: 240 ECTS; Minimum ECTS for application: 192 ECTS.
If the Bachelor's degree certificate is not yet available, only a provisional admission can be granted pending successful completion of the Bachelor's degree.
The Bachelor's degree certificate must be submitted no later than the end of the first Master's semester to obtain final admission.
It is strongly recommended to complete all required Bachelor's degree credits in the summer semester preceding the Master's program for a successful start.
Even if you have completed your degree at a university outside Germany, an online application through the Uni Assist portal is sufficient.
In addition to the required application documents, an application for credit transfer and a performance overview of completed credits must be submitted.
Application must be submitted by January 15 or May 15.
Credits that are not yet listed on the performance overview can be credited if an application for credit transfer is submitted with the application.
The program is restricted in admission for all semesters.
For the winter semester, it is possible to apply for the third semester.
For the summer semester, it is possible to apply for the second or fourth semester.
Admission to a higher semester can only occur if open study spots are available and the corresponding number of ECTS for accredited credits is available.
Credits are counted as equivalent for each 30 ECTS.
Up to 30 ECTS: Placement in the 2nd semester.
31 to 60 ECTS: Placement in the 3rd semester.
61 to 90 ECTS: Placement in the 4th semester.
If open study places are available and there are more applications for higher semesters, a ranking is created according to the valid selection regulations.

Further information on credit transfer regulations can be found in § 29 of the current Examination Regulations.
